MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

1. Parties
This mutual non-disclosure agreement (the "Agreement") is made between ExampleCorp and Calloway & Frost, the two parties identified in the signature block, each a "party" and together the "parties". The parties are considering a potential business relationship and wish to set out the terms on which they will exchange confidential information with one another.

2. Definitions
In this Agreement, "Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by one party to the other, in any form, that is marked as confidential or that would reasonably be regarded as confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure. It includes technical, commercial, financial, and operational information, as well as the existence and content of the parties' discussions. It does not include information that is public other than through breach of this Agreement, that the receiving party already lawfully held free of any confidentiality obligation, that is lawfully obtained from a third party, or that is independently developed without reference to the disclosing party's Confidential Information.

3. Confidentiality obligations
Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential, shall use it solely for the purpose of evaluating a potential business relationship, and shall protect it with at least the same care it applies to its own confidential information, and in any case with no less than reasonable care. Each party remains responsible for any breach of this Agreement by any person to whom it discloses the other party's Confidential Information.

4. Permitted disclosures
A party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, professional advisers, and affiliates who need to know it for the permitted purpose and who are bound by obligations at least as protective, and may disclose it where required by law, regulation, or a court of competent jurisdiction, provided it gives the other party prompt written notice where lawful.

5. Term
This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and continues for two (2) years unless terminated earlier in accordance with its terms.

6. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving thirty (30) days' written notice to the other party. Termination does not affect rights or obligations accrued before the termination date, and the confidentiality obligations survive for three (3) years after termination.

7. Return or destruction
On the other party's written request, each party shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information of that party in its possession or control and, if requested, certify the destruction in writing.

8. Limitation of liability
Each party's liability is capped at twelve months of fees. Neither party is liable to the other for indirect or consequential loss arising under this Agreement, and nothing in this Agreement excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

9. Governing law
This agreement is governed by the laws of New York. The parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York, over any dispute arising from or in connection with this Agreement.

10. Notices
Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and are effective when delivered to the registered office of the receiving party, marked for the attention of its legal counsel.

11. General
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter, supersedes all prior discussions, and may only be amended in writing signed by both parties. Neither party may assign or transfer its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent. If any provision is found unenforceable, the remainder of this Agreement continues in effect, and no waiver is effective unless given in writing and signed by the party granting it.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date of the last signature below.
